bias.en: Breakdown · gapped under every average, SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 破位 · 跳空跌破所有均线，SAR 转空

read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 14.2% on Nov 5 to $381.05, trading between $378.86 and $412.63 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($429.5) and 100-day ($445.0) and the rising 10-day ($433.8), 30-day ($434.5) and 200-day ($427.3) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 5 ($454.13), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月5日下跌 14.2%，收于 $381.05，盘中区间 $378.86–412.63，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$429.5）和 100 日均线（$445.0）以及上行的 10 日（$433.8）、30 日（$434.5）和 200 日均线（$427.3）下方。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 于 11月5日转为看空（$454.13），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The gap lower broke the whole $423.6–437 support band (200, 10 and 30-day averages, Oct 30 low), now resistance, leaving a gap from $412.6 to $432.8. Resistance is $406.9–412.7 (Sep 17 and Oct 15 lows, Nov 5 high), then $427.3–434.5 and $445. Support is $375.7 (Feb 17 low), then $365–369.4 (early-April closes) and $347.5 (March lows). A close above $412.7 would target $427–434; below $375.7, $365–369.
